category: 组合数学 / 计数组合
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only a concept/definition gloss. It fixes no sequence definition, finite carrier or partition representation, equality notion, ordered binders, boundary convention, or conclusion, and it does not choose a partition-cardinality characterization, Stirling-number sum, recurrence, generating function, Dobinski formula, or fixed-block-size result. Pinned mathlib defines Nat.bell recursively but explicitly leaves its indicated set-partition counting interpretation unproved. Selecting one candidate now would invent or substitute proposition-changing mathematics.
target_decision: preserve the conventional Bell-number and finite-set-partition family while redirecting the dependent statement phase to one independently approved source proposition; do not treat a definition, recurrence, or docstring as the absent cardinality theorem
domain_and_universes: Expected finite labeled carriers and natural-valued counts, with no nontrivial universe issue for a Fin n encoding; the exact carrier, arbitrary-finite-type transport, partition representation, decidability instances, quotient equality, arithmetic codomain, and any analytic universe or topology remain open.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not say whether to define Bell numbers by set-partition cardinality or prove a cardinality characterization, Stirling sum, recurrence, generating function, Dobinski formula, asymptotic, or another exact proposition.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before target selection; the empty carrier and B(0)=1, empty and repeated blocks, ordered versus unordered blocks, k=0 and k>n, arbitrary finite carriers, summation endpoints, recurrence reindexing, casts, and analytic convergence must be explicitly dispositioned.
